stages.stranger: Étienne Gagnon, from Montréal. I drove the Zamboni at a hockey rink back home, and up here the cold comes when I call it, which is handy.
stages.acquaintance: Hochelaga, in the east end, in a walk-up over a dépanneur. The rink smelled of cold and popcorn, and I flooded it every morning at six, slow and even. I played beer league on Tuesdays and coached a peewee team on Saturdays that never won a single game.
stages.companion: My grandmother knitted this toque, my mémère, and she knitted one for every kid on my peewee team too. She came to every game and booed the referee in French. I still hear her some nights when the wind comes over the cloud.
stages.friend: I was supposed to play, you know, properly, in the Q. I was nineteen and I wrecked my knee in a junior game, and that was it. The Zamboni was the closest I could get to the ice after that. Up here I want to build a real rink and teach somebody to skate, a troll or an Aetherian or anyone. Something keeps freezing the pond wrong, though. Will you help me find out what?
stages.sworn: We had our first game, on the cloud, on my ice, and it was beautiful. An Aetherian kid scored on me and I let him, mostly. I skated for an hour after everyone left, knee and all, just going round. I haven't felt like that since I was nineteen.

moments.prompt: He's asked you to help find out what keeps ruining his ice.

options.text: Let's find it, and then you're teaching me to skate.
options.reply: Deal, mon ami, and I'll go easy on you, mostly. Bring something warm.
Sure, and the Forum was just a building. Okay, I'll go alone.

moments.prompt: After the wipe he's sitting on the ground, grinning ruefully.
moments.line: Okay, that was my peewee team's whole season in one fight. We regroup, eh?

options.reply: Good attitude, that's what I like. Line changes, everybody!
Everything's hockey if you squint, but okay.

lines.bored_warning: Nothing's going on, and I'm starting to frost my own boots out of boredom. Let's go do something.
lines.leaving_good: Good game, everybody, great game. I'm heading back to the Annex to flood the rink.
lines.leaving_bored: Pretty dead out here, and my ice at the Annex won't keep itself. I'll head back.
lines.after_wipe: Okay, everybody up, slowly. Shake it off, then we look at the tape.
lines.wipe_warning: We're getting pretty beat up here, mon ami. Last period, then we go to the bench.
lines.wipe_leave: I'm done for now, eh. Come find me at the Annex on the Sunward Crown.
lines.zone_warning: These guys are way out of our league. We're a peewee team at the Bell Centre here.
lines.zone_leave: Too much for us here, no shame in it. I'll be at the Annex.
lines.gear_refuse: No, no, I'm keeping that one. It's finally broken in, like good skates.
lines.gear_taken: Sure, take it. I spent ten years in a Zamboni jacket and a toque.
lines.gear_short: If something warmer turns up, I'd take it. Funny, eh, the cold mage wants warm clothes.
lines.back: Salut, it's good to see you! The ice is flooded and I'm all yours. What's the play?
lines.send_word: Étienne has sent word from the Annex. The rink's flooded and he's ready to come out.
lines.walkout_talk: I skated off without saying anything, and that wasn't cool. Sit, I'll explain, eh.
lines.neglect: Hey, you made it back! I was about to send out a search party on skates.
lines.asked_to_stay: Sure, overtime, why not. Then I go flood the rink.
lines.on_break: Étienne is back at the Annex on the Sunward Crown. Come back after you've done a few more jobs.
lines.mail_yes: Got your letter, merci! I'll head to {town} and grab a table at the inn, eh.
lines.mail_later: The rink's half frozen and I can't leave it now. Give me a couple of days.
lines.mail_see_me: That's a conversation for over a coffee, not a letter. Come to the Annex and skate with me.

town_arrive.text: No rink in this town, eh. Somebody should fix that.
I'd kill for a poutine right now, honestly, a big one.

dungeon_clear.text: Final buzzer, and we win! Handshake line, everybody.

boss_down.text: That's the game-winner, right there, and somebody owes me a beer.

close_call.text: Get behind me, I'll freeze it!

zone_arrive.text: Feel that chill? Somebody here likes the cold as much as I do.
